title: Smart Data Models - Battery Pass - GeneralProductInformation
description:
Mandatory data: Product identification; manufacturer?s identification; manufacturing place; manufacturing date; battery category; battery weight; battery status (Annex VI, Part A and Annex XIII)

(Battery Pass Data Model aspect urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#GeneralProductInformation. Structure from the SAMM-generated JSON Schema; property names, descriptions and units from the current .ttl source, with names kept verbatim, including their original spelling.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Built as urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<battery passport id>, the same suffix for every aspect of one passport.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GeneralProductInformation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

productIdentifier.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#productIdentifier'. Unique identifier allowing for the unambiguous identification of each individual battery and hence each corresponding battery passport (exploration of a potential additional battery passport identifier (not requried per Battery Regulation) ongoing).
DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.2.2

batteryPassportIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#batteryPassportIdentifier'. Unique identifier allowing for the unambiguous identification of each individual battery and hence each corresponding battery passport (exploration of a potential additional battery passport identifier (not requried per Battery Regulation) ongoing).

batteryCategory.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#batteryCategory'. Categories relevant for the battery passport: LMT battery, ?electric vehicle battery, stationary or other industrial battery >2kWh.

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.3.5

contactName.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

addressCountry.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

postalCode.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

streetAddress.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

identifier.description: Not demanded by the EU Battery Regulation

manufacturerInformation.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#manufacturerInformation'. Unambiguous identification of the manufacturer of the battery, suggested via a unique operator identifier (as "unique string of characters for the identification of actors involved in the value chain of products", ESPR Art. 2(32)). 

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.2.4

manufacturingDate.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#manufacturingDate'. The manufacturing date should not only relate to the battery model, but to the battery item.

The date code should comply with DIN ISO 8601 1:2020 12 and ISO 8601 2:2019.

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.3.2

batteryStatus.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#batteryStatus'. Lifecycle status of the battery. Status defined from a list, with the options suggested as follows: 'original', 'repurposed', 'reused', 'remanufactured', 'waste'.

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.3.7

batteryMass.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#batteryMass'. Mass of the entire battery in kilograms. Voluntary: if the battery is defined on pack or module level: also weight of the modules and/or cells.

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.3.6 Units: 'kilogram' (SAMM unit, as declared in the source).

addressCountry.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

postalCode.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

streetAddress.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

manufacturingPlace.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#manufacturingPlace'. Unambiguous identification of the manufacturing facility (e.g. country, city, street, building (if needed)), suggested via a unique facility identifier (as "unique string of characters for the identification of locations or buildings involved in the value chain of a product or used by actors involved in the value chain of a product", ESPR Art. 2(33)).

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.3.1

identifier.description: Not demanded by the EU Battery Regulation

operatorInformation.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#operatorInformation'. State the name, trade name or mark, postal address, web ad-dress, e-mail address. Suggested reporting via a unique operator identifier (see requirements of unique battery identifier).

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.2.3

puttingIntoService.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#puttingIntoService'. Where appropriate, the battery passport must include information on the date of putting the battery into service. BR Annex VI Part A (1); Art. 3(33); Art. 38(7); ESPR Art. 2(32)

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.3.3

warrentyPeriod.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.BatteryPass.GeneralProductInformation:1.2.0#warrentyPeriod'. The battery passport must include information about the period for which the commercial warranty applies.

DIN DKE Spec chapter reference: 6.1.3.4 Units: 'month' (SAMM unit, as declared in the source).
